"""
r̄ = v̄×ō
        s̄ = ō×ū
        n̄ = ū×v̄
        `kᵣ` = r̄⋅(`C̄ₐ`-V̄)
        `kₛ` = s̄⋅(`C̄ₐ`-V̄)
        `kₙ` = n̄⋅(`C̄ₐ`-V̄)
        `x(θ,v)` =  (r̄⋅`D_A`(θ, v)+`kᵣ`delta(θ, v))/(n̄⋅`D_A`(θ, v)+`kₙ`delta(θ, v))
        `y(θ,v)` =  (s̄⋅`D_A`(θ, v)+`kₛ`delta(θ, v))/(n̄⋅`D_A`(θ, v)+`kₙ`delta(θ, v))
        where
        v̄: ℝ^3
        ō: ℝ^3
        ū: ℝ^3
        V̄: ℝ^3
        `C̄ₐ`: ℝ^3
        θ: ℝ
        v: ℝ
        `D_A`: ℝ,ℝ->ℝ^3
        `delta`: ℝ,ℝ->ℝ 
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, v̄, ō, ū, V̄, C_combining_macron_ₐ, θ, v, D_A, delta):
        v̄ = np.asarray(v̄, dtype=np.float64)
        ō = np.asarray(ō, dtype=np.float64)
        ū = np.asarray(ū, dtype=np.float64)
        V̄ = np.asarray(V̄, dtype=np.float64)
        C_combining_macron_ₐ = np.asarray(C_combining_macron_ₐ, dtype=np.float64)
        assert v̄.shape == (3,)
        assert ō.shape == (3,)
        assert ū.shape == (3,)
        assert V̄.shape == (3,)
        assert C_combining_macron_ₐ.shape == (3,)
        assert np.ndim(θ) == 0
        assert np.ndim(v) == 0
        # r̄ = v̄×ō
        self.r̄ = np.cross(v̄, ō)
        # s̄ = ō×ū
        self.s̄ = np.cross(ō, ū)
        # n̄ = ū×v̄
        self.n̄ = np.cross(ū, v̄)
        # `kᵣ` = r̄⋅(`C̄ₐ`-V̄)
        self.kᵣ = np.dot((self.r̄).ravel(), ((C_combining_macron_ₐ - V̄)).ravel())
        # `kₛ` = s̄⋅(`C̄ₐ`-V̄)
        self.kₛ = np.dot((self.s̄).ravel(), ((C_combining_macron_ₐ - V̄)).ravel())
        # `kₙ` = n̄⋅(`C̄ₐ`-V̄)
        self.kₙ = np.dot((self.n̄).ravel(), ((C_combining_macron_ₐ - V̄)).ravel())
        # `x(θ,v)` =  (r̄⋅`D_A`(θ, v)+`kᵣ`delta(θ, v))/(n̄⋅`D_A`(θ, v)+`kₙ`delta(θ, v))
        self.xθ_comma_v = ((np.dot((self.r̄).ravel(), (D_A(θ, v)).ravel()) + self.kᵣ * delta(θ, v))) / ((np.dot((self.n̄).ravel(), (D_A(θ, v)).ravel()) + self.kₙ * delta(θ, v)))
        # `y(θ,v)` =  (s̄⋅`D_A`(θ, v)+`kₛ`delta(θ, v))/(n̄⋅`D_A`(θ, v)+`kₙ`delta(θ, v))
        self.yθ_comma_v = ((np.dot((self.s̄).ravel(), (D_A(θ, v)).ravel()) + self.kₛ * delta(θ, v))) / ((np.dot((self.n̄).ravel(), (D_A(θ, v)).ravel()) + self.kₙ * delta(θ, v)))

\begin{align*}
\textit{r̄} & = \textit{v̄} × \textit{ō} \\
\textit{s̄} & = \textit{ō} × \textit{ū} \\
\textit{n̄} & = \textit{ū} × \textit{v̄} \\
kᵣ & = \textit{r̄} \cdot \left( C̄ₐ - \textit{V̄} \right) \\
kₛ & = \textit{s̄} \cdot \left( C̄ₐ - \textit{V̄} \right) \\
kₙ & = \textit{n̄} \cdot \left( C̄ₐ - \textit{V̄} \right) \\
x(θ,v) & = \frac{\textit{r̄} \cdot D_A\left( θ,v \right) + kᵣ \mathit{delta}\left( θ,v \right)}{\textit{n̄} \cdot D_A\left( θ,v \right) + kₙ \mathit{delta}\left( θ,v \right)} \\
y(θ,v) & = \frac{\textit{s̄} \cdot D_A\left( θ,v \right) + kₛ \mathit{delta}\left( θ,v \right)}{\textit{n̄} \cdot D_A\left( θ,v \right) + kₙ \mathit{delta}\left( θ,v \right)} \\
where \\
\textit{v̄} & : \mathbb{R}^{ 3} \\
\textit{ō} & : \mathbb{R}^{ 3} \\
\textit{ū} & : \mathbb{R}^{ 3} \\
\textit{V̄} & : \mathbb{R}^{ 3} \\
C̄ₐ & : \mathbb{R}^{ 3} \\
θ & : \mathbb{R} \\
v & : \mathbb{R} \\
D_A & : \mathbb{R},\mathbb{R}\rightarrow \mathbb{R}^{ 3} \\
\mathit{delta} & : \mathbb{R},\mathbb{R}\rightarrow \mathbb{R} \\
\\
\end{align*}
